method: The unmodified production Od scene with Ue avatar and Ba pet SVG renderers, exported in a VM containing only their pure rendering dependencies. No app initialization, authentication, network or account state is executed.

animations.changes: Only action selector scoping (.petscene.a-feed, .petscene.a-pat, .petscene.a-play); keyframes and durations are unchanged.

usage: Inline pet-care.svg inside an element with class petscene and load pet-care.css. Toggle a-feed / a-pat / a-play on the container; remove all action classes and force layout before replay. .ps-gain is intentionally empty: this is a preview, no account stats or rewards change.
distinction: This is a source-rendered interactive preview, not a video recording of a user session.
